title: "[bug] "
---

Use this form when the structured **Skill bug / 技能缺陷** template is not available. Security issues do not belong here; follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/LofiSu/recruiting-skills/blob/main/SECURITY.md) and do not post exploit details, API keys, or private candidate data.

## Skill

`researcher-recruiting-skill`, `research-talent-scout`, or repository / docs / CI.

## What happened

Expected behavior and actual behavior.

## How to reproduce

Commands, the prompt you gave the host, and a fixture path. Use synthetic records such as `research-talent-scout/tests/fixtures/records.jsonl` or `research-talent-scout/examples/sample-records.jsonl`. Do not paste real candidate records, private email addresses, or `OPENALEX_API_KEY` / `S2_API_KEY`.

## Environment

Host (Codex, Claude, Cursor, or GitHub Actions), OS, and Python version. Example: Ubuntu 24.04, Python 3.12, `bash tests/verify-all.sh`.
